headline: The window cools as day thins.
body: Shadows lengthen across the blotter. A bus idles at the corner, engine low. The page remains open, unread.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: pale gold fading to soft grey

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: wet pavement, two pairs of footsteps

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: low amber from the desk lamp
